from openpyxl import load_workbook

# Load the workbook to get the current value of A2 in 'Overview'
wb = load_workbook('/mnt/data/spreadsheet/8942/1_8942_init.xlsx', data_only=True)
ws_overview = wb['Overview']
selected_date_val = ws_overview['A2'].value

# Load the 'Pay Dates' sheet into a DataFrame for calculation
df_pay_dates = pd.read_excel('/mnt/data/spreadsheet/8942/1_8942_init.xlsx', sheet_name='Pay Dates')

# Ensure Date column is datetime
df_pay_dates['Date'] = pd.to_datetime(df_pay_dates['Date'])

# Convert selected_date_val to datetime
selected_date = pd.to_datetime(selected_date_val)

# Filter the 'Pay Dates' DataFrame for the same month and year as the selected date
month = selected_date.month
year = selected_date.year

monthly_data = df_pay_dates[(df_pay_dates['Date'].dt.month == month) & (df_pay_dates['Date'].dt.year == year)]

# Calculate the total of all paychecks (Paycheck 1 and Paycheck 2) for that month
# Fill NaNs with 0 to avoid issues during summation
total_monthly = monthly_data[['Paycheck 1', 'Paycheck 2']].fillna(0).sum().sum()

# Write the literal value to B5 in the 'Overview' sheet
# Note: The spreadsheet_content says B5 is "Total Monthly ...", but the answer_position is 'Overview'!B5.
# In openpyxl, B5 is row 5, col 2.
ws_overview['B5'] = float(total_monthly)

# Save the modified workbook
